title: Antarctic Sea Ice Fell 42% Below Its Old Average
hook: Antarctic sea ice fell 42% below its old average.
closing: Less reflective ice means more absorbed heat, reinforcing the warming everyone shares.
question: Did Antarctica's drop surprise you?

segments.say: Antarctic sea ice fell 42% below its old average. The frozen continent set a record low.
Antarctic sea ice was short by 1.3 million square kilometers. The missing area exceeded two huge states combined.
Antarctic sea ice reflects 60% of sunlight. Replacing it with dark ocean means more heat stays behind.
